question: With which of the following sports is the term ‘Chinaman’ associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Chinaman**

 
 
• A Chinaman **bowler** is basically a left-arm spin bowler who brings the ball into a right-handed batsman using his wrist as the source of spin.
